capabilities: Add or edit frontmatter properties across multiple notes
Apply changes to folders, file selections, search results, or open tabs
Choose overwrite, append, or ignore behavior for existing properties
Load default properties from a note
extras: Demo section is empty; README includes developer and manual testing instructions.
intentEvidence: add, edit, or remove frontmatter properties from multiple notes at once
motivation: To streamline managing metadata across a vault.
problem: Obsidian's property editor works one note at a time, so applying the same frontmatter change across many notes is manual and slow.
summary: Bulk frontmatter editor that adds, edits, or removes properties across folders, selected files, search results, and open tabs.
